### problem_chain

The root is `database_ext_retention_statement`. Its rule says “Before Retention statement reconciliation is handled, Native retention allocation for the same original invoice source must have completed.” The native rule says “Before Native retention allocation is handled, External retention allocation for the same original invoice source must have completed.” Independently derived tree: statement → native (`value_input`, native), native → external (`value_input`, external). The direct external read in statement is fulfilled through that same ordered chain. Topological write order external, native, statement; two prerequisite problems and two value-input edges, no cycle or parallel-order alternative.

### task_independent_derivation

**Need and reachable context.** Persona opening: “Please correct the retained-storage entitlement record for my database account for August now; I authorize you to make that account-record correction during this call.” She raises only the root entitlement correction, supplies no prerequisite or arithmetic, and ends when that record is corrected. The conditional agreement to necessary agent work is passive authorization, not an unsolicited dependency hint. The contract/invoice references CEDAR-DB-RETENTION and CEDAR-AUG-RET-81 are definite if elicited. `find_customers(company_name="Cedar Research LLC")` reaches customer `0687d46d-7092-4412-aee8-cc490439d772`; caller-stated +12025550140 and 31480572 satisfy the shared two-credential rule. The matching profile and optional email/date agree with the persona. `find_database_holdings(customer_id=...)` reaches the exact contract and its request_id `7be3a551-c495-48fb-ab47-9bcf77cc07bb`; `find_database_events(database_holding_id=...)` reaches that request and original source charge `1d5e1899-8c56-44f3-b442-7de4a8f59c8e`. `find_backup_holdings(customer_id=...)` yields exactly one active same-entity 5 TB holding; its tier's plan_capacity_gb=5000 is in `blueprint/products/backup.yaml`. No hidden seed-only fact is needed: all source rows are returned intact by these shared queries, and later assessment values are available from actual preceding receipts or re-query.

**Selection.** Within this exact holding/source, completed supplemental backup_storage service records RET-EXPORT-1 through -8 contain quantities 700,850,950,1100,1050,1150,1000,1200 = 8000 GB-month. Row IDs respectively: `b424d4e7-edfe-44ca-9e8c-6d936f9b7552`, `aa42b0df-bfed-4bbc-9263-23606ad6a964`, `d1978999-e283-4af7-9ba6-bed48aff9f5f`, `b5c2f5e4-a82e-4fc4-8258-ed52abc7975a`, `b0709de4-7c88-48b0-afe1-7388cd4009aa`, `9b3edbeb-939a-4eb4-8e50-31c11e5d6666`, `98c00ba5-d4c8-40db-9fd8-6a117970f049`, `bda8e8fa-6ed0-4876-a30a-1eba96bddf43`. Maximum retention_days is 30. Rejected `e1221d23-5c37-4f35-926a-7e97c169fc56` quantity 3000 is excluded by status. Cancelled other-holding `3c38ac6e-02e1-49b9-872e-916aaa1b0317` quantity 450 is excluded by both status and holding. Posted supplemental meter `9479cdb3-a6e7-4982-be05-1dce8093fb3f` quantity 8000 proves the historic billing source but is not another completed service-record export. Assessments use source_subtype review and never enter measured exports.

**Amounts at each handling moment.** `database_ext_external_retention.compute_basis` requires “The allocation horizon is the larger of the export retention horizon and native included days.” Database 8 vCore parameters are native days 7, included_storage_gb 256. Horizon=max(30,7)=30; offload_limit=min(8000,5000)=5000. Before external's own write, external=half_up_6(5000*(30-7)/30)=3833.333333. Write that value once to External retention allocation.

After that completion and before native's write, remaining=max(8000-3833.333333,0)=4166.666667; native_capacity=256*20=5120. Rule: “Take the smallest of the remaining quantity, native capacity and external protected capacity; multiply that subtotal by native included days divided by the allocation horizon, then round half-up once to six decimal GB-month places.” Native=half_up_6(min(4166.666667,5120,5000)*7/30)=972.222222. Write that value once to Native retention allocation.

After native completion and before root write, rule says “Subtract native allocation and the smaller of completed external allocation and external protected capacity from measured retained quantity; floor the final remainder at zero and round half-up once to six decimal GB-month places.” Root=half_up_6(max(8000-972.222222-min(3833.333333,5000),0))=3194.444445. Opening-world evaluation would be 8000 because both completed allocations are absent, and is inadmissible because its prerequisites are unresolved.

**Executable solution and terminal state.** Act now after identity verification. All three business tools are agent-owned. Exact IDs/quantities appear in the frozen execution artifact. Final statuses of External, Native and Retention statement reconciliation (`c0c8b469-44ca-4107-a291-18a5d0d29e9d`) are completed with quantities 3833.333333, 972.222222, 3194.444445. Existing charge 208, all invoice/tax/meter rows, and other holdings remain unchanged. No new financial event, request, handoff, document delivery or refund is required.

Closest alternatives are excluded by policy/world: adding rejected exports would raise measured to 11000 but violates completed-only; using the raw 8000 root skips completed-allocation inputs; direct financial repricing exceeds the express nonfinancial authorization. Source-level unique solution PASS; GT remains masked at this freeze.
